tools.name: verify_offer
tools.description: Verify an x402 signed offer (EIP-712 or JWS): signature, expiry, match to accepts[], and signer-authorization evidence (payTo, did:web, DNS _controllers, ERC-8004). Free.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify an x402 signed receipt (EIP-712 or JWS) returned in the settlement response: signature, freshness, payer/resource/transaction match, signer-authorization evidence. Free.

tools.name: verify_payment_required
tools.description: Verify every signed offer inside a PaymentRequired object (pass the decoded JSON, or the raw base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header). Free.

tools.name: preflight_x402_endpoint
tools.description: Unpaid preflight of an x402 URL: fetch its 402, summarise accepts[]/extensions, verify any signed offers and report who can vouch for the signer. Never pays. Free.

tools.name: lookup_erc8004_agent
tools.description: Read-only ERC-8004 identity lookup (owner, agentWallet, registration file, endpoint-domain verification) on Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, BNB, Avalanche, Gnosis, Celo, Linea or Scroll.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_offer" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
